steps.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳 · 獨立重算基準

steps.objectiveEn: Complete independently recalculate the baseline for 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
本階段計算任務：閱讀來源 System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：限匹配的同頻雙埠級聯，Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1；所有F與G用線性功率比，不把此簡式套入未處理鏡像的混頻器。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：F1=2、F2=5；G1先10再100；後級與溫度基準固定。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
依此處給定的條件手算量綱及數值，再以獨立試算欄重算。先辨認本階段使用的是名義輸入、變更後輸入或驗收殘差，不要直接抄用原答案。判準：輸入表應能唯一重建式 2+(5-1)/10 與 2+(5-1)/100，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 Analog Devices 的規格。
名義模型參考（輸入改變時須重新代入）：第一組：2+(5-1)/10 = 2.4 linear noise factor；第二組：2+(5-1)/100 = 2.04 linear noise factor。每個數值先標單位，先算括號與線性量，最後才換dB或百分比。
steps.instructionEn:
Investigation calculation: Read System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: For matched same-frequency two-port stages, Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1 using linear power ratios; do not apply the shortcut to an untreated mixer image band. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Set F1=2 and F2=5; increase G1 from 10 to 100 while holding the downstream stage and temperature reference fixed. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
Calculate with the conditions specified here, checking dimensions and repeating independently in a worksheet. Identify whether this investigation uses nominal inputs, changed inputs, or acceptance residuals; do not copy the baseline answer. Criterion: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 2+(5-1)/10 and 2+(5-1)/100 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to Analog Devices.
Baseline model reference (substitute again when inputs change): Baseline: 2+(5-1)/10 = 2.4 linear noise factor; changed case: 2+(5-1)/100 = 2.04 linear noise factor. Annotate units before evaluating parentheses and linear quantities; convert to dB or percentages only at the stated step.
steps.observation: 兩種重算的差異有量綱與捨入說明。第一組：2+(5-1)/10 = 2.4 linear noise factor；第二組：2+(5-1)/100 = 2.04 linear noise factor。每個數值先標單位，先算括號與線性量，最後才換dB或百分比。
steps.observationEn: The independent calculations reconcile with units and rounding accounted for. Baseline: 2+(5-1)/10 = 2.4 linear noise factor; changed case: 2+(5-1)/100 = 2.04 linear noise factor. Annotate units before evaluating parentheses and linear quantities; convert to dB or percentages only at the stated step.
steps.failure: 只複製同一公式兩次，未形成獨立核對；捨入掩蓋門檻差異。
steps.failureEn: Copying one formula twice instead of cross-checking independently, or rounding away a threshold difference.
steps.check: 輸入表應能唯一重建式 2+(5-1)/10 與 2+(5-1)/100，兩情境的改變量可追溯；不能把本題門檻標成 Analog Devices 的規格。
steps.checkEn: The ledger must uniquely reconstruct 2+(5-1)/10 and 2+(5-1)/100 and trace each changed quantity; do not attribute the exercise threshold to Analog Devices.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：限匹配的同頻雙埠級聯，Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1；所有F與G用線性功率比，不把此簡式套入未處理鏡像的混頻器。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：F1=2、F2=5；G1先10再100；後級與溫度基準固定。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: For matched same-frequency two-port stages, Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1 using linear power ratios; do not apply the shortcut to an untreated mixer image band. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Set F1=2 and F2=5; increase G1 from 10 to 100 while holding the downstream stage and temperature reference fixed. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
